forum.title: Wrong Baudrate for UART at NUCLEO-H563ZI with MX
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Heinz\_Baumer

Did you fit SB3 and SB4 to use HSE since they are not fitted by default?

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b8a2ebea-3605-46fe-b7c1-fbf4945bc343.png)

A factor of 3 exists between the configured baud rate and the expected baud rate. This difference can result from the use of the STLINK-V3 MCO output.

Open STM32CubeProgrammer, and click **Firmware upgrade**. Then open the tool in update mode, check the clock frequency in use, and enter that value as the input frequency instead of 25 MHz to obtain correct values.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/76ab28ac-63ce-4598-812b-b68bfff05b63.png)

You can seek this article for more details:  [article](https://community.st.com/stm32-mcus-60/how-to-use-stlink-v3-mco-output-on-nucleo-boards-as-a-precise-clock-source-for-stm32-140173)

BR

Gyessine
